title: Mailboxes follow staff joining and leaving
problem: Mailboxes had to be made and closed by hand when staff changed.
now: Inviting a user can make their mailbox; marking someone as left suspends it and forwards their mail.
steps: Invite a user with the mailbox box ticked.
Mark a staff member as left.
See their mailbox suspended and forwarded.
notes: Where: Settings › Users & roles · Staff & HR › a person › Leaving

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
